description: Recent reports regarding the NAQS recruitment process, including the release of the shortlist and the scheduled date for the Computer Based Test.

sections.heading: Shortlist Release Status
paragraphs: According to Punch Newspapers, NAQS has released the recruitment shortlist. However, LEADERSHIP Newspapers reports that the release of the recruitment shortlist has been postponed.

sections.heading: Computer Based Test Schedule
paragraphs: Punch Newspapers states that the Computer Based Test (CBT) has been fixed for August 20. Additionally, Legit.ng notes that the CBT assessment is drawing near.

sections.heading: Applicant Guidance
paragraphs: Legit.ng reports that NAQS applicants are being urged to check their status as the CBT approaches.

faq.q: When is the NAQS Computer Based Test scheduled?
faq.a: According to Punch Newspapers, the CBT is fixed for August 20.

faq.q: Has the NAQS recruitment shortlist been released?
faq.a: There are conflicting reports; Punch Newspapers indicates the shortlist has been released, while LEADERSHIP Newspapers states the release has been postponed.
